Note: 
1. These vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease as per 
the actual requirement for the teaching & patient care. The 
Competent Authority reserves the right of any amendment, 
cancellation and changes to this advertisement as a whole or in part 
without assigning any reason or giving prior notice. 
2. Reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines issued 
from time to time. 
3. All Candidates must have up-dated Medical Registration (NMC/ 
State Medical Council) with all post MBBS/MD/MS Qualification(s)). 
In case, candidate(s) do not have up-dated registration from Medical 
Council, they have to show and submit copy of "Applied for 
document(s)" to concerned authority at the time of interview. In 
case, these two clauses are not fulfilled, the candidate either may 
not be interviewed or their results will remain with-held in case the 
expert committee allows them to appear at the interview. Even after 
that, if, candidate selected, they must submit updated Medical 
Registration Certificate before joining. 
Candidates working in Govt./ Autonomous/ Statutory Institution 
should preferably have "NOC" at the time of Interview from their 
Employer. In case of immediate non- availability of the same, copy of 
"applied for NOC" and undertaking to be submitted at the time of 
Document Verification before allowing interview.  
4. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining as teaching 
faculty at ESIC Medical College & Hospital Surat (Gujarat). 
5. Reservation of Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) is as per prevailing 
guidelines of Government of India. In case candidates in these categories 
are not available, then the vacancies will be filled from the panel of 
candidates who attend the interview in view of essential services of the 
Medical College and for fulfilment of NMC Norms and reservation of PwBD 
shall be carry forwarded. 
6. The candidate appointed under PwBD quota will be adjusted against the 
vacancy of respective categories of SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General. 
7. Retired/Working Professor may also apply for the eligible posts. 
C. Eligibility Criteria: 
 Age Limit as on 23.11.2026: Not Exceeding 67 Years (except Senior Resident). 
 Age Limit as on 23.11.2026: Not Exceeding 45 Years (For Senior 
Resident), age relaxation as per the prevailing norms of Government of India (GOI). 
Note: The maximum tenure of such engagement will be till 70 years of age for teaching faculty 
whichever is earlier provided other rules & regulations are satisfied.  
D. Educational Qualifications: In accordance with the latest guidelines of the National 
Medical Commission (NMC/MCI). 
E. Pay and Allowances:  
Name of Post Remuneration 
Professor Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 1,18,500/- (Level 13) + Other Allowances* 
Associate Professor Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 78,800/- (Level 12) + Other Allowances* 
Assistant Professor Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/- (Level 11) + Other Allowances* 
Senior Resident Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/- (Level 11) + Other Allowances* 
376/A/ESICH/SURAT/Recruitment/2026-Admin I/4637626/2026
 
 
Note: *As per ESIC Headquarters Office Memorandum No. Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 
08.12.2022, or any subsequent orders issued by the Headquarters Office, eligibility will be 
determined accordingly. Additionally, non-medical officers, if selected, are not entitled to Non-
Practicing Allowance (NPA). 
Terms of Contract: 
i. The tenure of the contract of faculty will be for 1 year at the outset, with provision of 
further extension for a period of Two year subject to satisfactory annual performance, 
willingness and conduct of the candidate and the requirements of this institution. 
However, the contract will be terminated in the case of 
 (a) appointment/joining of a regular faculty on the same post or 
 (b) attainment of 70 (seventy) years of age; whichever is earlier between (a) and (b). 
ii. The Tenure of the contract of Senior Resident will be for 1 year at 
the outset, with provision of further extension for a period of Two years subject to 
satisfactory annual performance, willingness, and conduct of the candidate and the 
requirements of this Institution. However, the contract will be terminated in the case of 
(a) appointment/joining of regular incumbent (SR) on the same post or (b) attainment of 
50 (Fifty) years of age; whichever is earlier between (a) and (b). 
iii. The competent authority reserves the right to terminate the services at 
any time in the public interest, without prior notice or providing any reason. To 
resign from the position, the teaching faculty/SR must submit a one-month advance 
notice or deposit an amount equivalent to one month's salary. Failure to comply 
with this requirement will result in the forfeiture of both the one-
month salary and the security deposit, and may also lead to the initiation of legal 
proceedings. 
iv. The teaching faculty/SR shall not be entitled to claim any service benefits, including 
Provident Fund (PF), Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority, 
Promotion, or similar perks. 
v. Provision of Hostel accommodation/ Quarters will be made to the extent possible; 
however, it cannot be claimed as a matter of right. If facility of 
accommodation is availed, no HRA will be payable and the license fee and any 
other sum in lieu of HRA will be deducted as per rule. 
vi. Any instructions/Circular/policy issued from ESIC Headquarter Office, New Delhi from 
time to time on the subject will be applicable and binding to him/her. 
This being a contractual appointment, any absence from work exceeding 07 (seven) days 
without prior approval from the competent authority will be considered a voluntary 
abandonment of the engagement, resulting in automatic termination, forfeiture of both the 
one-month salary and the 
security deposit, and may also lead to the initiation of legal proceedings. The 
teaching faculty must record their attendance both manually and through the 
Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS) on a daily basis during 
scheduled working days. 
vii. Other terms and conditions will be applicable as issued by Competent Authority from 
time to time. 
 
 
 
376/A/ESICH/SURAT/Recruitment/2026-Admin I/4637626/2026

mentioned position via a Demand Draft payable to "ESI Fund

 How to Apply: 
1. Mandatory Offline Application Submission: Candidates must also bring their 
completed offline application form (attached with the advertisement) along with 
self-attested copies of documents as specified in Clause (J) and the 
provided checklist at the time of document verification. 
2. Document Verification and Interview: Only candidates whose documents are 
successfully verified by the Document Verification Committee will be allowed to 
appear before the Interview Board. 
3. Multiple Post Applications: Candidates may apply for multiple posts listed in this 
advertisement if they meet the eligibility criteria for each. A separate application, 
along with required documents and applicable fees, must be submitted for each 
post. 
4. Cut-off Date: The deadline for determining age, educational qualifications, and 
other eligibility criteria is 23-11-2026. 
 
 
 
 
376/A/ESICH/SURAT/Recruitment/2026-Admin I/4637626/2026
 
 
II.  Required Document(s) verification: 
Candidates must appear before the Document Verification Committee on the interview 
date prior to being permitted to attend the interview. They are required to submit 
their oﬄine application form (attached) along with self-attested copies of the documents 
listed below: 
i. Certificate of passing Class 10th for Date of Birth, 
ii. All Marks Sheets, Attempt, Degree Certificate of MBBS, 
iii. All Marks Sheets, Attempt, Degree Certificate of MD/MS/DNB/ Other 
Examination, 
iv. Valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD Certificate issued in format for appointment in 
Central Govt. job, wherever applicable, failing which he/she shall not be allowed to 
appear in interview for the reserved category. However, he/she can be treated as 
UR Candidate. 
v. State/ NMC Medical Registration Certificate (updated), 
vi. Proof of Publication(s), 
vii. Experience Certificate, 
viii. Recent Passport Size Photograph of Candidate, 
ix. Relieving/NOC Certificate from previous/current Employer, if applicable, 
x. Aadhaar Card, 
xi. Completion Certificate of ICMR/NMC approved Basic Course in Biomedical 
Research, if any, 
xii. NMC approved Revised Basic Course Workshop/Basic Couse in Medical Education 
Workshop Certificate, if any.  
Required Documents/ Certificate mentioned at Sl. No.(i) to (xii) shall be verified with 
original document(s) /Certificate. If not verified any applicable document(s) by the 
Document Verification Committee, no candidate shall be allowed in the Interview. 
K. Selection Procedure: 
i. Selection will be made on basis of acquired academic credentials and performance 
of candidate in interview, which will be conducted by the duly constituted 
selection board.  
ii. Result will be published only in Recruitments section of Website: www.esic.gov.in 
iii. Offer of Appointment will be sent through E-mail only. 
iv. Selected candidates will have to join as per instructions mentioned in offer of 
appointment. 
L.  Important Note: 
i. The Candidate(s) may ascertain their eligibility and should report for interview on the 
scheduled date and time for Interview. 
ii. The EWS candidates should submit Valid EWS Certificate as per Annexure-
I of Govt. of India, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions, DOPT Office 
Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res). 
iii. The Valid OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate should be issued and not 
prior to 01 (One) Year from the date of cut-off date as mentioned in clause I. It has to be 
as per the format applicable for appointment under the Govt. of India and to be issued 
by an Officer not below the rank of Sub-Divisional 
Officer or Equivalent Authority of the concerned State for Central Govt. job. 
iv. Application should be submitted for each post separately and in the prescribed format 
only. The application submitted in any other format or incomplete application will be 
summarily rejected.

v. Wrong declarations/submission of false information or any other action contrary to law 
shall lead to cancellation of the candidature at any stage. 
vi. Mere submission of Application does not confer any right to the Candidate to be 
eligible for Interview unless they report on the scheduled date and time for Interview 
with required documents as mentioned. 
  
Opportunity of interview given to candidates will be on provisional basis subject to detailed
 scrutiny of eligibility criteria. 
  
vii. The Dean, ESIC MCH Surat (Gujarat) reserves the right to cancel/ postpone the 
Recruitment Process at any stage at its discretion without any notice and such decision 
will be binding on all concerned. 
viii. No TA/ DA will be paid to candidate(s) for appearing in the Interview or submission of 
any document. 
ix. All applicants must visit the website www.esic.gov.in regularly since all subsequent

DATE: 16.11.206 
Walk-in Interview  for a Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)  
Interview date & time: November 26, 2026 (26.11.2026) / 10:00 am at NIPER-Raebareli (transit 
campus), Lucknow 
National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Raebareli (NIPER-R) is an autonomous Institute 
of National Importance set up by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, 
Govt. of India by an act of Parliament, to impart high-quality education  & Research in the area of 
Pharmaceutical Sciences. The Institute intends to fill the position of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) 
under ICMR intermediate grant (Project title: Translational Advancement and Optimisation of Oral Sustained -
Release Microparticle Platform for Parkinson’s Therapy)  under supervision of Dr. Ashok K. Datusalia,  
Associate Professor, Department of Pharmacology and Toxicology , through a walk-in interview on a purely 
contractual basis.  
 
Name and 
Details of the 
Position 
Qualification and Experience Maximum Age 
limit

(One) 
 
Salary: 56000/- 
plus HRA as 
applicable  
 
Duration: 
Initially for one 
year, extendable 
up to three years 
based on 
performance or 
till project 
duration 
 
Essential Qualifications: 
(i) MS Pharm (Pharmacology & Toxicology/Regulatory Toxicology/ 
Biotechnology)/ M Pharm (Pharmacology)/ MTech 
(Biotechnology/ Bioscience)/ MD (Pharmacology/ Pharmacology 
& Toxicology), MVSc (Pharmacology/ Pathology/ 
Biotechnology)/ MSc (Life Science/Biochemistry/ Neuroscience/ 
Biotechnology/Biological Science ) with a minimum 60% 
aggregate or 6.75 CGPA 
OR 
(ii) (Second class post -graduate degree in aforementioned 
disciplines with Ph.D.  Aforementioned qualification(s) must be 
from the recognized Board/ University/ Institute.  
 
Desirable Qualification: Preference shall be given to a candidate 
with  
1. PhD degree in relevant discipline and qualified  in 
GPAT/GATE/CSIR-NET/CSIR-JRF/DHR-BRET or Eq national 
exam 
2. Candidates having experience in Drug Discovery, NCE 
screening; in-vivo neuro-pharmacology models and behavioral 
experiments; mammalian cell culture, transfection experiments 
3. Demonstrated writing skills with publications in highly reputed 
journals related to the project/work 
4. Aptitude for strong commitment to experimental research, 
mentoring and knowledge dissemination to the lab members; to 
run the project independently 
35 yrs. 
 
The upper age 
limit is relaxable 
up to 5 years in 
the case of 
SC/ST/OBC/ 
women and 
physically 
handicapped 
candidates as per 
Govt of India 
norms. 
 
➢ The candidates int erested in the above area of research and for the above post may send in the 
prescribed application form ( format attached) with complete information and attachments 
(certificates/documents) along with CV in advance  to the PI by e -mail 
ashok.datusalia@niperraebareli.edu.in 
➢ The candidate  should also bring the application form along with CV and all photocopies of 
certificates/documents regarding educational qualifications, work experience, etc. 
 
 
Page 2 of 2 
 
➢ The interview shall be conducted on November 26, 2026 (26.11.2026)  / 10:00 am at NIPER -
Raebareli (transit campus), Lucknow . Candidates reporting after 11:00 AM shall not be 
considered for the interview. 
➢ The interview shall be conducted preferably in physical mode. However, a highly interested candidate 
may request to appear online with request to the PI by email ashok.datusalia@niperraebareli.edu.in 
along with completed application form and relevant document. 
 
Candidates may also note the following points:  
1. Incomplete application or those without relevant supporting documents (self-attested copies of Date of 
birth/Degrees/ Certificates/ Mark sheets/Experience Certificates/documents, etc.) will not be 
interviewed. 
2. On the recommendation of the Selection Committee, the competent authority may relax all or any of 
the requirements related to age and experience in exceptionally meritorious cases. 
3. NIPER Raebareli reserves the right to fix suitable criteria for short -listing of eligible  candidates. The 
project team will have the right to put any screening criteria in case large numbers of applications are 
received.  
4. Please note that no TA/DA will be given to the candidates called for the interview. 
5. The offer of project position is purely of temporary in nature for a one year initially and extended 
further till the project duration based on performance and does not confer any right for absorption in 
NIPER Raebareli. 
 
For any further information/clarifications, the applicants may contact PI directly by email.
